Image Gallery

BoobaStudio's Image Gallery lets you browse, search, and manage all AI-generated images you have generated. View your creations, reuse images across documents.

Overview

The Gallery is a visual browser that displays all images generated through BoobaStudio. It keeps your generation history in this browser, letting you find and reuse previous creations.

How It Works

  • Open the Gallery — from the BoobaStudio menu or welcome screen
  • Browse Images — scroll through your generated images
  • Filter & Search — narrow results by type or ownership
  • Select an Image — click to view full size
  • Apply — use the image in your current document or download it

Accessing the Gallery

From the BoobaStudio menu

  • Open the BoobaStudio radial menu
  • Select the Gallery/Browser option

From the Welcome Screen

  • Open the BoobaStudio welcome screen
  • Click the Gallery card in the features grid
  • Or click View Gallery in the gallery preview section

From Document Sheets

When generating images for actors, items, or scenes, the gallery is accessible as an alternative to generating new images.

Gallery Features

Image Filters

  • All — show all images from the community
  • Own — show only your generated images

Image Details

Click on any image to see:

  • The original prompt used to generate it
  • The model that was used
  • The generation date
  • Full-resolution view

Pagination

Images are loaded in pages as you scroll. The gallery loads more images automatically when you reach the bottom.

Download

Right-click or use the download button to save any image to your local machine.

Tips

  • Browse for inspiration — see what prompts and models other users are using
  • Reuse existing images — instead of generating new ones, check if you already have something suitable
  • Gallery entries are stored in this browser — they persist across sessions and worlds

Requirements

  • BoobaStudio module installed and configured
  • A configured image provider
